cleanupBlockNumber().notice: Get the current cleanup block number.

setCleanerContract(address).notice: Set the contract that is allowed to call history cleaning methods.

setCleanupBlockNumber(uint256).notice: Set the cleanup block number. Historic data for the blocks before `cleanupBlockNumber` can be erased, history before that block should never be used since it can be inconsistent. In particular, cleanup block number must be before current vote power block.
